title: Detailed windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x='0' y='88' width='100' height='12' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <rect x='0' y='88' width='100' height='2' fill='#66bb6a'/>

  <!-- windmill body (tapered tower) -->
  <polygon points='38,88 62,88 58,42 42,42' fill='#d7ccc8'/>
  <polygon points='38,88 62,88 62,78 38,78' fill='#bcaaa4'/>
  <!-- brick lines -->
  <line x1='40' y1='78' x2='60' y2='78' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='68' x2='59' y2='68' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='58' x2='58' y2='58' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='48' x2='57' y2='48' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- vertical brick -->
  <line x1='50' y1='78' x2='50' y2='68' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='48' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='46' y='76' width='8' height='12' rx='4' fill='#5d4037'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='82' r='1' fill='#ffd54f'/>

  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='46' y='52' width='8' height='8' rx='1' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <rect x='49.5' y='52' width='1' height='8' fill='#d7ccc8'/>
  <rect x='46' y='55.5' width='8' height='1' fill='#d7ccc8'/>

  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='36,42 64,42 50,28' fill='#c62828'/>
  <polygon points='36,42 64,42 50,42' fill='#b71c1c'/>

  <!-- windmill blades hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='4' fill='#ffd54f' stroke='#ff8f00' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- blade 1 - up-right -->
  <g transform='rotate(0 50 36)'>
    <rect x='47.5' y='10' width='5' height='22' fill='#8d6e63' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='18' fill='#efebe9' rx='1'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='12' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='20' x2='56' y2='20' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='25' x2='56' y2='25' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='15' x2='56' y2='15' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>

  <!-- blade 2 - right-down -->
  <g transform='rotate(90 50 36)'>
    <rect x='47.5' y='10' width='5' height='22' fill='#8d6e63' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='18' fill='#efebe9' rx='1'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='12' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='20' x2='56' y2='20' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='25' x2='56' y2='25' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='15' x2='56' y2='15' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>

  <!-- blade 3 - down-left -->
  <g transform='rotate(180 50 36)'>
    <rect x='47.5' y='10' width='5' height='22' fill='#8d6e63' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='18' fill='#efebe9' rx='1'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='12' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='20' x2='56' y2='20' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='25' x2='56' y2='25' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='15' x2='56' y2='15' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>

  <!-- blade 4 - left-up -->
  <g transform='rotate(270 50 36)'>
    <rect x='47.5' y='10' width='5' height='22' fill='#8d6e63' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='18' fill='#efebe9' rx='1'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='12' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='20' x2='56' y2='20' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='25' x2='56' y2='25' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='15' x2='56' y2='15' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>

  <!-- hub cap -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#fff59d'/>

  <!-- small path -->
  <path d='M46,88 Q44,92 40,96 L48,100 L52,100 L58,94 Q54,90 54,88 Z' fill='#a1887f' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- little bush -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='86' r='5' fill='#43a047'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='88' r='4' fill='#388e3c'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='88' r='3.5' fill='#66bb6a'/>

  <!-- sun -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='16' r='8' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <g stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='82' y1='4' x2='82' y2='1'/>
    <line x1='94' y1='16' x2='97' y2='16'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='16' x2='67' y2='16'/>
    <line x1='90.5' y1='7.5' x2='92.5' y2='5.5'/>
    <line x1='73.5' y1='7.5' x2='71.5' y2='5.5'/>
    <line x1='90.5' y1='24.5' x2='92.5' y2='26.5'/>
    <line x1='73.5' y1='24.5' x2='71.5' y2='26.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- birds -->
  <path d='M70,30 Q72,27 74,30' stroke='#90a4ae' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76,26 Q78,23 80,26' stroke='#90a4ae' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
